title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | The Grounds & Clubs Deep Dive
summary: Enter the world of The Grounds in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, where Clubs, kickabouts, and all-new social spaces connect players like never before.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Your Club’s world just got a lot bigger. The Grounds is the most social way to play EA SPORTS FC™ 27, bringing up to 100 players together in a shared football playground, built around a central Terrace and three distinct districts inspired by football…

sections.title: The World
sections.summary: The Grounds is built around a central Terrace that connects three distinct districts, each shaped by different football cultures. From social spaces and in-world activities to Clubs and Stadium competition, each area offers different ways to explore, play,…

sections.title: Mentors
sections.summary: Mentors will guide you through everything The Grounds has to offer, with each player having their own specialist area: Alex Hunter Returns from The Journey as your right-hand man, helping guide you through player improvement challenges inspired by his rise…

sections.title: Ways to Play
sections.summary: The Clubs experience now lives inside The Grounds, including the return of Leagues and Playoffs. Walk into your Clubhouse to jump straight into all of the ways to play in Clubs experience.

sections.title: Kickabouts
sections.summary: Kickabouts mix football with other sports like Dodgeball, Basketball, or Bocce Ball to introduce a variety of new ways to play both cooperatively and competitively. Bocce Ball is a three-player free-for-all played over three one-minute rounds.

sections.title: Archetype Changes
sections.summary: Along with tuning updates across all existing Archetypes, we’ve made some changes to how you build, develop, and customize your player Archetypes in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. First, all Archetypes are now unlocked by default, giving you immediate access to any…

sections.title: Masteries
sections.summary: Masteries represent your long-term growth as a complete footballer. Every Archetype you develop leaves a lasting mark on your Pro.

sections.title: Amps
sections.summary: Amps are a new type of item that give you more control over how your Archetype performs on the pitch. When equipped, they add specific benefits to your active Archetype for a limited time.

sections.title: Consumables
sections.summary: Consumables continue to provide ways to progress your Archetype outside of playing matches. The Grounds introduces new Consumable variations designed to help players who join later in the year catch up on Archetype progression.

sections.title: Club Objectives
sections.summary: New Club Objectives give you and your Clubmates more ways to progress together and earn unique rewards. Some objectives focus on shared achievements in Clubs, such as winning five League matches, while others will track your Club’s combined progress across…

sections.title: Customization
sections.summary: Showcase your Achievements and create your own football-inspired style through a range of Clothing and Accessories, including items from some of your favourite brands. You can customize your street and stadium looks separately to express your identity on and…

sections.title: Emotes
sections.summary: You can assign up to eight Emotes to the Emote Wheel and trigger them to interact with others across The Grounds. Emotes are also used in the post-match rewards sequences in Kickabouts and Small-sided as celebrations.

sections.title: Stores
sections.summary: You can find customization options, emotes, cosmetic bundles, and more in the various in-world stores throughout The Grounds. All of the in-world Stores feature different customization outfits, attire, cosmetic bundles, accessories, and emotes, while the…

sections.title: Season Pass
sections.summary: Play The Grounds and complete objectives to earn Season Points and unlock rewards including outfits, accessories, emotes, Amps, Consumables, and Coins. Upgrade to the Premium Pass for additional rewards as you progress through the seasonal reward track.
